claim: As the Guardian reports in a story shared by Contributing Editor Michaela Haas, thanks to an innovative roof and ceiling design, natural breezes ventilate the space without air conditioning.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: The Guardian (via AOL, 25 Sep 2026): the terminal 'is cooled by a light tropical breeze, the result of natural ventilation'; the roof creates low pressure that 'funnels wind into the building', and 7.5-metre ceiling fans circulate it. Euronews (11 May 2026): the arrivals terminal has no air conditioning.
